notes.title: New Game Special Announcement & Pricing
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27777811/ef33e1911b3834f4ca0e8505a4e227fead32dd40.png"][/img]Hi everyone!
I am very happy to announced that after a very long break, [b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784750/Sea_of_Tranquility/"]Sea of Tranquility[/url][/b], a new game is underway!
Sea of Tranquility is a sci-fi adventure with open world gameplay, optional quests, alternative endings and many other features. There may even be an easter-egg reference to Trajectory.

I hope you will check it out and consider adding it to your [b]Wishlist[/b].

[b]Special price announcement[/b]

Trajectory is not that long away from turning a decade old already! To celebrate [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784750/Sea_of_Tranquility/"]Sea of Tranquility[/url], Trajectory will be available for [b]FREE[/b] for the Steam community soonish.

Thanks for everyone who played.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27777811/ec1b5419b0d9c50a70ca22cecf52a163671d9a6a.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Game Bundle!
notes.content:
Hi guys! A Collection of Bad Moments was just released and all [b] Trajectory owners can get the brand new game at 3.2 $[/b] with the an exclusive 20% discount!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27777811/7c21bb8a289ea7e8bb31cb59dec5f21c15eb9d6d.png[/img]

A Collection of Bad Moments is an adventure game where the player discovers themselves in various tough situations and must use their wits to figure a way out! The moments vary from a deadly asteroid mission and mysterious virtual reality simulation to an airship duel!

notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/717120/A_Collection_of_Bad_Moments/

notes.title: VR Support
notes.content:
Hi!

For now, the official support for VR on the Store Page list is turned off in order to avoid any disappointments. This will be reinstated as soon as we have fully tested VR functionality after release.

However, the game does support HMD with keyboard & mouse controller setup for HTC Vive, Oculus Rift and OpenVR!

In the Settings, under Gameplay & VR, you can toggle a on a VR Mode, making the game tailored for VR experience by removing all potentially nausea inducing camera movements, adjusting speed etc.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27777811/56368e0ce56f063096d8d1e8700dbc9e7748fc0a.jpg[/img]
